$comment: Known SCF round shortfalls: rounds where the directory carries fewer awards than SCF's own round page lists, each naming the SCF award pages (https://communityfund.stellar.org/project/<slug>) no served row carries in that round, the intake list in improvements/TODO.md. A ratchet read by scripts/eval/scf-round-counts.ts after every enrich-scf execute: a short round not listed here, a listed round whose shortfall grew, any round where ours is over SCF, and a listed SCF page no row carries that its round's entry does not name fail; a listed round whose shortfall shrank or closed, and a named page that is carried now, also fail until the entry is lowered or the page dropped. Entries are only ever lowered or removed, never raised or added, except in a reviewed change. An entry whose counts agree (scf equal to ours) records a swap and must name its pages. Since sls-116 the check reads every page outside SCF's 531-row listing that a round page names, so those pages are named and judged by slug too; an award with no project page is named by its submission record id and is not judged.
basis: Predicted, not yet measured: SCF's 46 round pages, the 531-row listing and the 216 project pages outside it, read 2026-11-12, against the served directory as the curate-projects and enrich-scf plans of the sls-116 change leave it (the enrich plan run read-only with --rows-from https://www.stellarlight.xyz over the rows curate's execute leaves). The Round counts step after those executes confirms it or names each round that differs. Of the 27 awards still uncarried: 5 sit on Draft rows (the-hub, octo, ramm, multiclique, elio-dao), 6 have only a Draft candidate, 4 have a row of the page's name and no link to confirm it, 1 SCF #44 page and 7 earlier pages have no row, 2 awards have no project page, and boss-money and the interstellar platform need a person (improvements/TODO.md). Peer's copy of the Peer by HoneyCoin award is counted once, on honey-coin (SCF_SHARED_CLAIMS).
